title: UC span links must stay inside their source trace location
answers: Why does a span link on a Unity Catalog trace point to the wrong trace or get dropped?
How are span links handled for traces stored in a UC trace location?
Can a span on a catalog.schema trace link to a trace in another location?
Why does add_link skip my link for a UC trace?
body:
Invariant: a link on a UC trace (request ID `trace:/catalog.schema/...`) may only target a trace in the same UC location. Bare (`abc123`) and `tr-` targets are qualified with the source location; targets carrying a different `trace:/` location are not stored.
Enforcement: mlflow/entities/span.py:_normalize_link_trace_id returns the qualified ID, or None for cross-location targets. It is called from mlflow/entities/span.py:LiveSpan.add_link, mlflow/entities/span.py:Span.from_otel_proto and mlflow/entities/span.py:_link_from_otel_link.
Native OTel links on UC spans are preserved, not dropped; the old 'links not supported for UC' drop paths were removed.
Skipping the check conflates traces from different UC locations, so a link resolves to a trace the user never meant to reference.
applies: Any change to span link construction, LiveSpan.add_link, or OTLP link conversion for UC (`trace:/`) traces. Does not change behavior for non-UC traces, whose links are used as-is.
says: Span links on catalog traces connect to the wrong execution trace.
A trace link between spans in different catalog locations disappears or fails.
Clicking a linked span in a catalog trace opens an unrelated trace.
Ensure trace links only resolve to executions within the same catalog location.
search: Span links on Unity Catalog traces must target the same location, enforced by mlflow/entities/span.py:_normalize_link_trace_id. Called by LiveSpan.add_link, Span.from_otel_proto, and _link_from_otel_link, this helper qualifies bare and tr- IDs with the source location while dropping cross-location targets. Native OpenTelemetry links are preserved rather than dropped to prevent links from conflating across different catalog locations. This applies to trace:/ span link construction and OTLP conversion without altering non-UC traces.
